text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak witnesses the commissioning of seven naval ships at a flag raising ceremony.
- Egypt beats Senegal 2-0 in an African Nations Cup qualifier in Alexandria.
- Ninety suspected Moslem militants to be tried by a military court.

- Egypt seeks a balanced U.N. resolution condemning Jewish settlements. Assistant foreign minister, Sayyed Qassem el-Massri, said Egypt was consulting with foreign countries at the United Nations on the draft resolution.
- The High Dam Authority announced emergency measures to deal with the Nile flood this year.
- The Arab Lawyers Union urges Arab countries to boycott the economic summit in Doha, Qatar.
